exposure: Women with vaginal delivery after midurethral sling surgery
Women with cesarean delivery after midurethral sling surgery
cohort: 728 women in Sweden who underwent midurethral sling surgery, with a study group (n=207) who had subsequent deliveries and a control group (n=521) who did not
finding: Childbirth after a midurethral sling procedure was not associated with an increased risk of patient-reported SUI.
mod_finding: Continence status was not affected by the mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) in women who had a childbirth after midurethral sling surgery.
